# Company logo sources

These files identify the employers listed in Mohamad Moallem's CV. They are
stored locally so the portfolio does not depend on third-party image hotlinks.

- **SATCON Africa** — `satcon.png` is the exact logo supplied by the owner on
  3 November 2026. No company destination was supplied, so this mark is not linked.

- **Upgrade Your Game** — `upgrade-your-game.jpeg` is the official website's
  270 px logo, downloaded from
  <https://upgradeyourgamelb.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/cropped-upgrade_your_game_logo-270x270.jpeg>.
  Its primary LinkedIn page links to that website in its launch announcement:
  <https://www.linkedin.com/company/upgrade-your-game/>.
- **Salem Group** — `salem-group.jpg` preserves the logo already supplied in
  the original portfolio's `src/data/portfolioData.js` experience entry.
  Destination: <https://www.linkedin.com/company/salemgroup/>. The primary
  company page identifies its Beirut office in Justinian Building and links to
  <https://www.salem-grp.com/>. The same employer's 2025 remote software
  internship advertised React, Node.js, and MySQL at
  <https://careers.beirutdigitaldistrict.com/2563/show/job>.

Checked 3 November 2026. Company marks remain the property of their owners.
